source.citation: Cui et al., Metropolitan-scale ion-photon entanglement via a quantum network node with hybrid multiplexing enhancements, Nature Communications 17, 697 (2026)
source.parameter_location: main text Figs. 2, 4, and 6; Supplementary Information
source.provenance_role: primary Cui repeater-node baseline for the histogram device stack

validity.distance_semantics: source-reported one-way fiber from the ion node to the remote photon detector
validity.route_scope: demonstrated one-node ion-photon repeater component; the paper's two-node midpoint-BSM mapping is projected rather than demonstrated

hardware.resource_semantics: demonstrated five-ion crystal with four shuttled communication ions and one protected D5/2 memory ion

rate_model.rate_semantics: measured heralded ion-photon rate at one node; never substituted directly for a two-node memory-memory pair rate

state_model.state_semantics: heralded ion-photon Bell fidelity after mode-dependent feed-forward
state_model.activation_blocker: ion-photon fidelity is not a remote memory-memory process channel; synchronized two-node joint-mode statistics and midpoint-BSM conditioning remain required

storage_decoherence_model.coherence_time_definition: source-reported Ramsey-with-echo Gaussian fit for the protected D5/2 memory ion

memory_model.detected_decay_semantics: D5/2 spontaneous decay is detected by mid-circuit measurement and enters heralded delivery loss, not conditional-state noise

controller_model.scheduling: component descriptor delegates to configs/physical/controllers/cui_hybrid_12km_component_literature.json and remains fail-closed for a two-node elementary pair

activation_blockers: the demonstrated 4.28/s rate is ion-photon, not ion-ion
the 44 mode launches reuse four communication ions and are population-correlated
two-node synchronized joint-mode probabilities and midpoint-BSM conditioning are not reported
the exact nonuniform launch schedule and periodic-cooling phase are not fully specified for the compiled controller

notes: Primary demonstrated Cui repeater-node baseline. Existing low-level histogram memory, conversion, and controller descriptors already use this 12 km experiment; adding this service profile changes provenance selection only and does not replace runtime defaults.
